result:
This all looks correct and minimal. The implementation is complete.

## Summary

Made the Excerpt field optional and derived from the body when left blank:

- **`app/Support/excerpt.ts`** (new) — `deriveExcerpt(body)`: returns the trimmed body unchanged if ≤140 chars; otherwise takes the first 140 chars, pulling back to the last whitespace if character 141 would split a word (falling back to a hard cut at 140 if there's no whitespace at all), trims trailing whitespace, and appends `…`.
- **`app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`** — `excerpt` in `PostPayloadSchema` is now `.optional()` (still trimmed, still capped at 500 chars) and transforms a missing value to `''`; title/body validation is untouched.
- **`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`** — `store` and `update` now compute `excerpt = data.excerpt || deriveExcerpt(data.body)` before saving, so a blank/whitespace-only excerpt is replaced by the derived one on both create and update (an update re-derives from the *new* body), while a provided excerpt always wins.
- **`resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx` / `Edit.tsx`** — label now reads "Excerpt (optional)" with a placeholder explaining the fallback; no client-side requirement was ever enforced, so no other JS change was needed.
- **`.guren/api-client.gen.ts`** — regenerated via `bun run codegen` so the generated `excerpt?: string` type matches the relaxed schema.
- **Tests**: `tests/excerpt.test.ts` unit-tests `deriveExcerpt` against both worked examples plus boundary/edge cases; `tests/PostController.excerpt.test.ts` adds HTTP-level coverage (via `TestApp.actingAs` + `withCsrf`) for create-with-blank-excerpt, create-with-explicit-excerpt, update-re-deriving-on-cleared-excerpt, and blank-title still failing validation.

`bun run typecheck` and `bun test` (13 tests, including the pre-existing suite) both pass.
